source: Use A8.2's exact no-update checkpoint, predeclared first-action negative raw vector and frozen 32-note panel.
one_structural_mask: Selected relay-to-motor edges whose source's encoder preferred time-to-contact is exactly 500000 or 400000 microseconds; all such edges and no others.
intervention: Apply the unscaled full A8.2 first-action negative raw change only on this fixed mask. Clip retained components independently to the existing 0–2 mV bounds. Leave every other selected weight at no-update value. No redistribution or renormalization.
primary_endpoint: First upward on-threshold crossing of the 20-ms motor spike window, relative to no update and full candidate.

interpretation_locked_before_probe.useful_far_direction: Far-cue-only component moves first crossing at least one 1-ms tick later than no update without silence.
interpretation_locked_before_probe.opposing_far_direction: Far-cue-only component moves crossing earlier than no update.
interpretation_locked_before_probe.inconclusive: Crossing is unchanged or absent, or exact state/reference reproduction fails.

prohibitions: no M2 claim from one state
stop: Save one branch, exact comparison, independent audit and report; stop before a new candidate-rule stage.
